audit_metadata.audit_title: Post-Remediation Verification and Replay-Only Customer Pilot Rehearsal
audit_metadata.auditor_role: Principal Application Security Engineer, Senior SRE & SaaS Reliability Auditor

steps_executed: 7. Inspect Operational Readiness Dashboard & Audit Logs

verification_gates.name: Tenant Isolation and Server-Side Authorization
verification_gates.initial_finding: CRITICAL: Investigation and Repair database models lacked explicit org_id columns. Data purge endpoint executed delete(Repair) and delete(Investigation) without tenant scoping when incident_key was omitted, allowing cross-tenant data destruction.
verification_gates.remediation_applied: Added org_id column to Investigation and Repair models via migration 008_add_org_id_to_investigations_and_repairs. Scoped all database queries, deletes, and read endpoints strictly to the authenticated organization claim. Added in-flight worker checks to abort persistence if the investigation was purged during graph execution.

verification_gates.name: SSRF and TOCTOU DNS Rebinding Defenses
verification_gates.initial_finding: HIGH: SafeTelemetryHttpClient validated hostnames via DNS lookup prior to dispatch, but httpx.Client executed an independent DNS resolution upon connection, presenting a Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) DNS rebinding vulnerability. In addition, IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses (::ffff:169.254.169.254) and integer IP formats bypassed string-based checks.
verification_gates.remediation_applied: Implemented SSRFProtectedSyncBackend and SSRFSafeTransport to pin and verify the physical connected peer socket (sock.getpeername()[0]) before transmitting any HTTP bytes. Added parse_ip_representation to unwrap IPv4-mapped IPv6, integer, hex, and octal encodings. Changed execute_query default to allow_private=False.

verification_gates.name: Secret Redaction Lifecycle and Data Governance
verification_gates.initial_finding: HIGH: Secrets embedded in trace logs or error messages (Bearer tokens, standalone JWTs, database connection URI passwords, and email addresses) could reach external LLM prompts if sanitize_untrusted_text only stripped specific keywords.
verification_gates.remediation_applied: Integrated comprehensive regex sanitization in redact_sensitive_text and redact_sensitive_data covering Bearer tokens, JWTs, URI credentials (postgresql://user:pass@host), key-value tokens, and email PII across prompt building, report persistence, and HTTP error handling.

verification_gates.name: Read-Only Invariants and Mutation Prevention
verification_gates.initial_finding: NONE: Code inspection confirmed GitProvider implementations enforce read_only=True by default and raise PermissionError on write operations.
verification_gates.remediation_applied: Verified server-side enforcement across GitHubProvider and LocalGitProvider. Confirmed that human approval records audit decisions but does not trigger git pushes, branch creation, or cloud infrastructure mutations.

verification_gates.name: Administrative Kill-Switches and Emergency Controls
verification_gates.initial_finding: MEDIUM: Celery worker tasks did not check investigations_paused before executing queued background investigation jobs.
verification_gates.remediation_applied: Updated investigate_incident_task in backend/workers/tasks.py to check PilotGovernancePolicy.investigations_paused prior to graph execution and abort immediately if paused. Updated gather_evidence_node to fail closed on policy read failure.

verification_gates.name: Incident Data Governance and Cascading Purge
verification_gates.initial_finding: CRITICAL: Global deletion of MetricObservation and Event tables during tenant purge could destroy telemetry for other tenants in shared storage.
verification_gates.remediation_applied: Constrained metric and event purge strictly to services verified for that organization's investigations. Added Redis cache pattern invalidation (*{org_id}*) and audit logging. Guaranteed operator feedback is immutable and triggers zero model training.

verification_gates.name: Pilot Replay Rigor and Provenance Grounding
verification_gates.initial_finding: NONE: All 10 cases in shadow_pilot_cases.json are honestly labeled as SANITIZED_REPLAY_FIXTURE with live_telemetry_verified: false. Answer keys are physically isolated in ground_truth/ and never leaked to prompt generation.
verification_gates.remediation_applied: Independently verified metrics: Top-1 accuracy 80% (8/10), Top-3 recall 80% (8/10), MRR 0.80, 100% citation grounding, 100% correct abstention rate on noise/maintenance scenarios.
